preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= 10**6 for c_i in c)
preconditions.description: Each initial flag color c_i must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= d_i <= 10**6 for d_i in d)
preconditions.description: Each desired flag color d_i must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The lengths of the initial and desired color lists must match the number of cities n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_j <= n and 1 <= y_j <= n for x_j, y_j in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid city indices within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must start with 'Yes' if a valid route exists.
The output must start with 'No' if no valid route exists.
If a valid route exists, the length k must match the number of cities in the route.

postconditions.expression: all(c_i == d_i for c_i, d_i in zip(c, d))
postconditions.description: After the route, the flag colors must match the desired colors.
